name: Natsuyasumi Neko-chan
original_name: なつやすみネコちゃん
source:
"Neko-chan," a shy girl who is not good at talking, started an exchange diary with everyone in her friend group during the summer vacation.

A cat who learns from her exchange diary that her friend saw the rumored ghost "Mr. Makkuro" at school.

From that moment on, strange things began to happen around the cat...

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6886]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
害羞、不善言谈的女孩“Neko-chan”在暑假期间与朋友圈的大家开始了交流日记。

一只猫从她的交换日记中得知她的朋友在学校看到了传闻中的幽灵“真黑先生”。

从那一刻起，猫的周围开始发生奇怪的事情……

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6886]NovelGame[/url]]
